card.name: "That" after drugs or medications
card.fires_on: The word "that" right after "drugs" or "medications", opening a clause about what those drugs do (inhibit, lower, slow, cause). Seen in interaction and contraindication text.

modes.label: Relative "that" after drug class
modes.description: "that" introduces a clause describing drugs with a given effect or property.
modes.example: taking DRSP with other drugs<< that>> may affect electrolytes, such as ACE

modes.label: End of a drug name
modes.description: Rarely, the final part of a macrolide name before a statement about its enzyme role.

card.writes: It prepares a description of drug properties, and pushes away words for requirements or demands.
card.plain: It fires on "that" in phrases like "drugs that lower blood pressure" in interaction warnings.
